A hosted MCP server also gives compatible AI clients access to traces, datasets, and evaluations.

name: SupaPark (Merlin)

name: Stacked
tagline: A quiet, ad-free table for daily puzzles, twelve games, one payment.
desc: Stacked is a calm, ad-free browser game table with twelve classic puzzles: Sudoku, Mahjong, Solitaire, Word Search, Daily Word, Color Sort, Nonogram, 2048, Spider, Minesweeper, Block Puzzle, and Mini Crossword. Players get two free boards of each game every day. After that, a single one-time unlock opens everything forever, no ads, no subscription, no noise.

name: Undersky
tagline: Discover your birth chart and what makes you you
desc: Your birth chart should feel like a doorway into self-understanding, not a wall of symbols. Undersky gives you a free, beautifully presented chart and clear explanations of the placements and patterns that make it yours. Explore at your own pace, even if you don't know your exact birth time. When you want a deeper look, a personal Deep Reading brings the story together in a keepsake you can revisit.

name: Funeral Papers
tagline: Everything you need to say goodbye, made with care
desc: When someone you love dies, there is so much to say and arrange. Funeral Papers helps you tell their story once and turn it into the pieces that bring people together: a thoughtful obituary, a eulogy you can read with confidence, a memorial page, a printed program, cards, and a tribute video. Start with a free obituary and memorial page.

name: hirly
tagline: Scored job matches, tailored resumes, ATS forms filled for you
desc: hirly is a job application tool for engineers, data scientists, product managers and designers who are actively job hunting. It scores every live job listing against your profile with a visible A-G breakdown across role fit, remote policy, tech stack and seniority. It then drafts a resume and cover letter written against that specific job description, and fills the application form on real ATS pages, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, Workable, SmartRecruiters and LinkedIn, through a Chrome extension. Applying stays per-job and consent-based: you review the filled fields and press submit yourself, or opt a single job into autonomous submission.

name: JPG Tools Kit
tagline: Private browser JPG tools to compress, convert, resize, and edit JPEGs, no upload
desc: JPG Tools Kit is a free set of browser-based JPEG tools. Everything runs locally in your browser so files never leave your device. No signup. Part of the TinyToolkit network of privacy-first format tools.

desc: Cron Kit is a free set of browser-based cron expression tools. Explain schedules in plain English, validate across dialects, generate from text, and convert for Quartz, AWS EventBridge, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, systemd, and more. Everything runs locally in your browser. No signup. Part of the TinyToolkit network of privacy-first format tools.
